subject: Plot a data frame in a same bar chart

messages.author: f2ffcd9cf4497ee0
messages.subject: Plot a data frame in a same bar chart
parts:
Hello,

My question is probably basic and has been asked thousand of time...
I'm new to ggplot2 and I'm having a hard time find my way in the
documentation, tutorial, etc, to do what I used to do with the regular
R package.
My probel is that I have a data frame called "model1" formated like
that:

time ring1 ring2 ring3 ring4
1 boat chair unk boat
2 boat chair unk boat
3 boat chair unk boat
...

I want a bar chart showing the percentage of the factors (boat, chair,
unk) as a function of the ring. As far as I understand, this is not
directly possible with ggplot. I have to plot each ring separately,
then combine the plot on the output device. Is that right?

I also need to plot the rings as a function of time. I use to do that
with the regular image() function with factors coded by an integer
(boat=1, chair=2, unk=0). Is there a way to do the same think with
ggplot2 without the coding part?

Regards,
Nicolas
